lede: Ohio State carries the stronger underlying team rating — +10.1 against +6.2, a 3.9-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Texas +2.6 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Ohio State winning 57% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is depth, where Texas leads Ohio State by 64 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 41% — enough to publish, not enough to treat the exact margin as settled.
